lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let p (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
      (_ : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis))
      (_ : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) : Prop :=
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change p a b (Basis.mem_span _ a) (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction₂
  · rintro x y ⟨φs', rfl⟩ ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    let sl := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
    let before := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) sl
    let both := fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    let bothL := List.filter both φs'
    let bothR := List.filter both φs
    let after := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) sl
    let u := ι (ofCrAnListF before)
    let v := ι (ofCrAnListF bothL)
    let w := ι (ofCrAnListF bothR)
    let z := ι (ofCrAnListF after)
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, p]
    calc _
      /- Split the commutator. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
            superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
        module
      /- Simplify the signs. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
        module
      /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
        (u *
            v *
            ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
            w *
            z -
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
        u *
            v *
            ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
            w *
            z) := by
        have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
          (by simp_all only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl, and_self,
    implies_true])
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append], h1]
        have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
          (by simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, decide_not, Bool.decide_and,
    List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, and_self, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl, implies_true])
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, u, before, sl, v, bothL, both, w, bothR, z,
    after]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (u *
            v *
            (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
            w *
            z) := by
          simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (u *
            v *
            ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            w *
            z) := by
          congr
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
            ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
          simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
    simp only [u, before, v, w, z]
    repeat rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append]
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
    rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by grind only),
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  all_goals simp_all only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_mul, map_add,
    mul_add, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, implies_true, p]

simp_all only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl, and_self,
    implies_true]

simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, decide_not, Bool.decide_and,
    List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, and_self, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl, implies_true]

simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, u, before, sl, v, bothL, both, w, bothR, z,
    after]
simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]

simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
